{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wise Laws of Rana''' was a set of ancient laws created by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]] to govern her subjects on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] around the same period when the planet was being brought into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At least one scroll was inscribed with the Wise Laws of Rana and left within the [[Valley of Royalty]] as a treasured artifact from Duro's antiquity.<ref name="MfMY">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>

This scroll would be taken by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]], [[Dustini Spa Ronii]], in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="Essential Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> after [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] began scourging Duro for artifacts to bring to the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]]. The scroll containing the laws, alongside several other relics, were ferried by Dustini to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], known as [[Mount Yoda]], for safe keeping.<ref name="MfMY" />
